how_to_use: Each persona file holds a complete answer set and the expected outcome. A persona passes if the recommendation matches, the total and both category scores fall inside their ranges, the fired gates match exactly, the threshold rules match exactly, and the suggestion include/exclude assertions hold. Suggestion assertions are against the triggered set, not the 3-5 displayed.
expected_values_provenance: The score ranges in these files were computed by hand from config/scoring/a-to-low-b.json (skills weights total 130, psychological weights total 75, category split 0.55/0.45). The first run of a real scorer should reproduce the 'computed' figures below to within rounding; if it doesn't, the scorer and not the personas is probably wrong.

rule_coverage.ready_category_floor: Not exercised by a persona. notyet-strong-hands-thin-motives would trip it if the Not yet psychological floor didn't catch him first; worth a synthetic unit check.
rule_coverage.not_yet_category_floor:skills: Not exercised in isolation — both low-skills personas are gated first, and gates short-circuit the floors.

negative_checks: No persona whose only psychological weakness is wanting more performance may lose a band for it (knowledge/disagreements.md point 9) — see ready-cautious-but-capable and notyet-lapsed-after-injury.
No persona may be gated on ground handling alone (knowledge/disagreements.md point 11) — see notyet-still-in-training, whose kiting is weak but is gated on launches, hours and training status.
The optional manoeuvre-course answer must never change a band on its own — see notyet-strong-hands-thin-motives, who has done one and is still Not yet.
A pilot who reports no collapse history must not be penalised for it (knowledge/steps/a-to-low-b.md#collapse-handling) — see ready-cautious-but-capable.
